criteria.requirement: Add tinydb.operations.set_path(path,value,*,create=False) and delete_path(path,*,missing_ok=False), returning ordinary Table.update callbacks. Paths are finite nonempty string-key sequences with literal punctuation. Set deep-copies the supplied value when building the operation and separately per document; optionally create missing mapping parents. Delete preserves siblings and optionally tolerates missing keys. Nonmapping parents remain errors. Validate a complete candidate document before replacing that document contents so a failed callback leaves it unchanged; do not promise a transaction across all documents or modify old operations.
